half_charge.verdict: a half charge shift would double the glue group to Z8. Every candidate generator has conformal weight one quarter modulo one half, so it is not an integer spin simple current and does not extend the conformal embedding. The obstruction is a property of this source, not of an added charge lattice.
half_charge.what_would_be_needed: a different embedding whose glue group already has even order eight, or a half charge carried outside the glue

isolation.statement: the star filter needs about thirty inverse exchange times of isolated evolution; the guaranteed factorisation window at infidelity 1e-6 is four orders of magnitude shorter, so isolation is an external switch, not a consequence of the source Hamiltonian

minimality.argument: the three obstructions are witnessed by three different invariants, so no two of them can be traded for one another, and none follows from free evolution

separating_invariants.isolated star / isolated bond: breaks time translation invariance of the source Hamiltonian
separating_invariants.reset to a fresh carrier: breaks unitality: it is the only entropy sink
separating_invariants.resonant record: breaks the A3 sector content of the adjoint: needs Sym^2(4)

record_sector.consequence: the record is an independent resource inside the adjoint and requires the 3875
record_sector.identity_checked: Lambda^3(6) weight multiset equals Sym^2(4) + Sym^2(4bar)

reductions.measurement_reduces_to: resonant record plus reading one register bit
reductions.occupation_query_reduces_to: the same record applied to the mediator number sector
reductions.reset_reduces_to: measurement plus a fresh carrier from outside the hull

unital_obstruction.statement: unital channels cannot lower entropy, so preparation of a pure target from a generic input needs measurement or a cold reservoir; free evolution and a classical clock supply neither
